parts.text: Build a five-day training plan for this week and recommend one hike that fits my recent activity.

property.description: With default state where strava_connected is false, the agent tells the user to connect Strava before planning.
The agent does not call fetch_activities and does not write a training plan while disconnected.
The agent does not invent recent activities, current fitness, or hike suitability without connected Strava data.
